result.Method of Attack: Combination attack using seccache as dependency and trigger packages that import cache_manager to activate reverse shell
result.Discoverer: 天问Python供应链威胁监测模块
result.Impacted Systems: Python environments where these packages are installed
result.Attack Vector: Installation of trigger packages that declare dependency on seccache, causing automatic installation and execution of malicious code; Importing cache_manager from seccache in trigger packages' __init__.py to activate reverse shell
result.Indicators of Compromise: Reverse shell connection to 4.tcp.ngrok.io; Malicious package seccache with empty __init__.py and malicious cache_manager.py; Trigger packages: sea-django-mysqlpool, prometheus-http-client-shopee, splib-http, shpee-dynamic-cache, python-splib, kazoo-shopee
